## Required before review

- [ ] I added the correct label for the changelog
- [ ] I updated or checked any relevant docs
- [ ] I tested the change
- [ ] I filled in the notes below

## Changelog label

Add the label that best matches this PR so the release notes file it into the right section.
If this is missing, the release notes may be wrong.

- `docs` / `documentation` for documentation-only changes
- `feature` / `enhancement` for new functionality or improvements
- `bug` / `fix` for bug fixes

## What changed?

Briefly describe the change and why it was needed.

## Testing

Describe how you tested the change.

## Release notes / reviewer notes

Add anything reviewers or release notes should know, such as:

- user-facing changes
- breaking changes
- migration steps
- follow-up work needed after merge
